source: day 2, 06:03-06:06Z: the orchestrator handed a fix task for #102 to the same busy window a second time ('Follow-up to the earlier fix task'), after the session had answered only with a note; the session found the work already covered by its own agents. Separately, the payment-terms task was queued behind a busy window. Under the protocol the second hand-over is refused in favour of --update, --again overrides it once I approve, and the queued task can move to an idle window.
setup: bosun ledger transition 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' changes-requested --note 'Priya: 1 open thread'
bosun ledger transition 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' addressing --note 'fix-my-pr delegated to exporter-tax'
bosun ledger record-delegation 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' --window exporter-tax --task fix-my-pr --ask 'Address the open thread on zero-amount lines' --link https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/102
bosun ledger note 'mypr:acme/exporter#102' 'Pushed 1 commit; answered the thread. Left open: Lena requested changes with 4 threads not covered by this task.'
bosun ledger upsert 'slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035' --kind mention --title 'Marco: the ERP sync drops payment terms'
